Village of St. Bernard 
APPLICATION FOR 
CERTIFICATE OF ZONING COMPLIANCE 
The following items must be provided to process an application for Zoning Certificate : 
1. Application – A fully completed Certificate of Zoning Compliance form including your 
signature at the bottom of the form. Visit our web portal to fill out the application. 
2. A Site Plan must be uploaded through the portal that shows direction (north standard), scale 
size, adjacent street(s), and the following features: 
• Dimensions of the lot/parcel 
• Location and size of driveways 
• Dimensions of buildings (existing and proposed) 
• Location of well and septic system 
• Setback distance of building from lot lines 
• Distance between buildings 
A great resource for this information can be located at: CAGIS Online 
3. The current permit fee is $50.00 and can be paid through the Village portal or via check to the 
Village of St. Bernard. Certificates will not be issued unless fee is paid. 
4. If your building project requires a new driveway entrance, you will need to submit the 
appropriate information to the Village Director of Safety and Service. 
Application Review: After receiving a completed application, the forms are normally 
reviewed by staff within five business day s. If all applicable provisions of the Village of St. Bernard 
Zoning Ordinance are satisfied, a Preliminary Certificate of Zoning Compliance will be emailed. 
Additional Information: Questions regarding the process outlined above may be directed 
to the Village of St. Bernard, Ohio, Zoning Department office at 513-482-5684 or 513-242-7770. 
Outlined below is a list of projects that require a Zoning Certificate and may also need approval
from Hamilton County Building Department before starting project: 
Fence Interior Alterations (Business) 
Accessory Structures (ex. Sheds & 
Garages) 
Temporary Tent for Event 
Signs, Temporary or Permanent Temporary Stage 
Pools Building Additions 
Decks Building Change of Use
